# Datavault AI Highlights Data Futures Platform Patent Amid Tokenized Stock Exemption


October 15, 2026 1:25pm EDT


### Allowed patent application covers asset valuation, tokenization, transaction verification, and blockchain-enabled marketplaces as a new federal framework opens the door to on-chain trading of tokenized stocks


**PHILADELPHIA, PA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 15, 2026 /** Datavault AI Inc. ("Datavault AI" or the "Company") (NASDAQ:DVLT), a provider of data monetization, credentialing, digital engagement, and real-world asset ("RWA") tokenization technologies, today announced that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office has issued a notice of allowance for its Method and System for Data Futures Platform patent application (U.S. Patent Application No. 17/441,847), and highlighted the relevance of the disclosed technology to a significant development in the regulatory landscape for tokenized securities.


On September 17, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission[announced a temporary, conditional "Innovation Exemption"](https://pr.report/sdyo) intended to facilitate on-chain trading of certain tokenized National Market System stocks through qualifying Tokenized Securities Venues. The action represents a meaningful regulatory development for market participants exploring blockchain-based securities infrastructure, subject to the conditions and investor protections established by the Commission.


Datavault AI's Data Futures Platform patent application describes systems and methods for assigning value to data assets, generating tokens, facilitating transactions through digital marketplaces, and recording transaction verification. The application also describes blockchain-based transaction records, tokenized asset management, and mechanisms for valuing and monetizing assets over time.


"Tokenization is moving from concept to regulated market infrastructure, and that shift puts a premium on the ability to value assets, verify transactions, and manage tokens with confidence," said Nathaniel T. Bradley, CEO of Datavault AI. "Our Data Futures Platform patent application describes exactly those building blocks, and we believe it positions Datavault AI to contribute meaningfully as businesses and financial market participants evaluate the technologies that will support the next generation of digital asset markets."


**Connecting Digital Asset Valuation, Tokenization and Transaction Infrastructure**


The patent application describes a platform architecture designed to support the conversion of data and other value-based assets into transactable digital representations. Among its disclosed capabilities are:


Asset valuation and monetization: Methods for evaluating data assets using market factors, transaction history, demand, and other valuation inputs.


Tokenization and digital marketplaces: Mechanisms for representing value through tokens and facilitating transactions through digital exchanges and marketplaces.


Transaction verification and recordkeeping: Systems for recording transaction information and maintaining verification records, including embodiments using blockchain-based ledgers.


Asset management and future-value applications: Frameworks for tracking asset value and facilitating transactions based on present and anticipated future value.


These disclosed concepts may be relevant to the broader development of digital asset markets, where reliable valuation, transaction records, token management, and transparent marketplace operations are important components of market infrastructure.


**A New Federal Framework for Tokenized Stock Trading**


The Commission's[September 17 order](https://pr.report/sdyp) establishes temporary, conditional relief for qualifying venues trading certain tokenized National Market System stocks and for specified liquidity providers. Among other requirements, participating venues must comply with limits on eligible securities and trading volumes, provide required public disclosures, deploy auditable smart contracts, and confirm that tokenized stocks provide holders with the same rights and privileges as the equivalent traditional shares.


The order is not a blanket authorization for tokenized securities platforms, does not eliminate applicable securities-law obligations, and does not constitute an endorsement of Datavault AI or its intellectual property by the Commission. It provides a defined framework under which qualifying market participants may explore certain on-chain trading models while the Commission evaluates the market and considers potential future regulatory action.


Against this backdrop, Datavault AI believes its intellectual property portfolio merits consideration as businesses and financial market participants evaluate technologies for digital asset valuation, tokenization, transaction management and marketplace development.


**Exploring Potential Applications Across Digital Markets**


As tokenization expands beyond traditional cryptocurrencies, technologies that support the identification, valuation, exchange and verification of digital assets may have applications across multiple markets. Datavault AI's Data Futures Platform disclosure provides a foundation for evaluating potential applications involving tokenized data assets and other digital representations of value.


The Company intends to assess how its intellectual property and technology capabilities align with emerging market requirements, potential commercial partnerships, and evolving regulatory frameworks.


**About Datavault AI**


Datavault AI™ (NASDAQ: DVLT) is leading the way in AI-driven data experiences, valuation, and monetization of assets in the Web 3.0 environment. The Company's cloud-based platform provides comprehensive solutions with a collaborative focus in its Acoustic Sciences and Data Sciences divisions.


Datavault AI's Acoustic Sciences division features WiSA®, ADIO®, and Sumerian® patented technologies and industry-first foundational spatial and multichannel wireless, high-definition sound transmission technologies with intellectual property covering audio timing, synchronization, and multi-channel interference cancellation. The Data Science division leverages the power of Web 3.0 and high-performance computing to provide solutions for experiential data perception, valuation, and secure monetization.


Datavault AI's platform serves multiple industries, including high-performance computing software licensing for sports & entertainment, events & venues, biotech, education, fintech, real estate, healthcare, energy, and more. The Information Data Exchange® enables Digital Twins and the licensing of name, image, and likeness by securely attaching physical real-world objects to immutable metadata, fostering responsible AI with integrity. The Company's technology suite is fully customizable and offers AI- and machine-learning-based automation, third-party integration, detailed analytics and data, marketing automation, and advertising monitoring.


The Company is headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. Learn more about Datavault AI at[https://dvlt.ai](https://pr.report/sdyq) .
